currency: $ as printed on the page (no currency code given; read as USD)
notes: Off-peak is half the peak rate. Peak is 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday, except Chinese public holidays. Everything else is off-peak. cost.py applies the windows per request from its timestamp and does not know the holiday calendar, so a run on a Chinese public holiday is priced slightly high.

The router's usage table records input and output tokens only, not how many input tokens were cache hits. cost.py prices every input token at the cache-miss rate, so the input cost is an upper bound (cache hits cost 2 percent of that).

DeepSeek also bills server-side Search and Fetch at $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests, but that does not apply here: Useful Bot's web_search goes through the router's own search provider. cost.py reports the router's search_hits count for the window and does not price it.
The model name on the page is deepseek-flash; the legacy name deepseek-v4-flash is billed at the same Flash price. The router rows for this app carry model deepseek-flash.
